reports.title: RBC Bearings Incorporated Announces Fiscal Second Quarter 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook for the Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
section: The Company expects net sales to be approximately $520.0 million to $525.0 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2027, compared to $461.6 million in the prior year, for a growth rate of 12.7% to 13.7%. Gross margin is expected to be in the range of 45.5% to 45.75% and SG&A as a percentage of net sales is expected to be in the range of 16.25% to 16.5%.
